recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for FHIR-21643. Handle FHIR-57216 and FHIR-57219 separately if they receive final work-group decisions about target list mode cardinality or deprecation.
issue_request: FHIR-21643 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the FHIR mapping language. It asked to document target list modes, rename target list mode collate to single, and update the ANTLR grammar so share carries the extra id represented by StructureMap.group.rule.target.listRuleId.
initial_application: Commit 8bf663efea9f377e93c88ed8eda187f7c08b00d6 partially applied the issue for R5 by changing collate to single in images/mapping.g4 and source/structuremap/codesystem-map-target-list-mode.xml. It did not remove the mapping-language TODO, did not permit share:<id> in the grammar, and gave single the share definition instead of preserving the former collate semantics.
additional_context: The edited files are in current build scope: source/fhir.ini lists StructureMap as active, source/hierarchy.xml includes mapping-language.html under Implementation Support, and publish.ini includes mapping-language.html and mapping.g4. FHIR-20324 was retracted after confirming share/listRuleId implementation support. Later FHIR-57216 and FHIR-57219 are Submitted R6 questions and do not supersede this Published decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/mapping-language.html to describe first, share:listRuleId, last, and single; changed images/mapping.g4 so targetListMode parses share ':' ID; corrected source/structuremap/codesystem-map-target-list-mode.xml so share matches the Jira resolution and single has the old collate behavior; clarified source/structuremap/structuredefinition-StructureMap.xml so listRuleId explains its role with share.
source_changes: images/mapping.g4: targetListMode now requires share ':' ID for the share form.
source/mapping-language.html: target transform list_modes documentation now explains first, share:listRuleId, last, and single and links listRuleId.
source/structuremap/codesystem-map-target-list-mode.xml: share definition now matches the Jira resolution and single now uses the former collate behavior.
source/structuremap/structuredefinition-StructureMap.xml: listRuleId definition now states that it identifies shared target instances when listMode is share.

related_jiras.note: Earlier share/listRuleId implementation concern was retracted after the reporter confirmed Java reference implementation support.
